title: Validation of a Unique Boxing Monitoring System
retraction_or_correction_status: no retraction or correction recorded in OpenAlex at accessed_at
notes: cited_by_count 24 at harvest; a citation count is a measure of attention, not of correctness
methodology: Development and validation of a wearable punch-performance sensor system against Kistler force plate and Vicon capture by linear regression.
main_findings: Wearable punch measurement reached R2 0.97-0.99 against laboratory gold standards for force, acceleration and velocity.
limitations: an instrument paper, not a boxing finding
project_implications: Matters for how future evidence arrives rather than for canon: it is the tool that would let punch data be gathered outside a laboratory.
